posts.title: You could have built Jev
posts.description: At the end of this (short, simple, illustrated) article, you should be able to reason about Jev from first principles.

posts.title: Maybe Software Stops Being the Default
posts.description: I used to write little translators for my bank exports. Then ChatGPT wrote them. Now nobody writes them: I hand an agent the file. As agents get better at following instructions, more tasks stop needing durable, task-specific software at all.

posts.title: Chat, we've made a terrible mistake...
posts.description: I hit enter too early on a message to Claude and it identified the fundamental design flaw in our codebase before I could describe it. Three LLMs had signed the thing off as essentially perfect. Nobody was in "are we solving the right problem" mode.
